title: Airbyte Job Failures
dataSources: Fivetran log-service events and REST API (`connectors`, sync status), Airbyte job logs (`airbyte:job`), Matillion task history, Kafka Connect connector/task status, AWS Glue job runs (CloudWatch), ADF pipeline runs (Azure Monitor).
app: Fivetran / Airbyte / Stitch / Matillion logs and REST APIs via HEC scripted inputs; Kafka Connect JMX/REST; cloud ELT via `Splunk_TA_aws` (Glue) and `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices` (ADF).
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=airbyte:job event=job_completed
| stats count as jobs, sum(eval(status="failed")) as failures by connection_name, source_name
| eval failure_rate=round(100*failures/jobs,1)
| where failures>0
| sort - failure_rate
description: Tracks Airbyte sync job outcomes and ranks connections by failure rate so broken open-source ELT pipelines are caught quickly.
value: Airbyte failures stop data reaching the warehouse just like any ELT tool; failure-rate ranking focuses effort on the least reliable connections.
implementation: Ship Airbyte job logs to HEC; schedule hourly; alert on failures for critical connections.
visualization: Table by failure rate, timechart of job failures.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the open-source data-copy jobs and flag when one keeps failing so the feed gets fixed.
